summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with embedded systems experience across STM32, Jetson (Linux), and Raspberry Pi. Built FreeRTOS firmware, interrupt-driven UART bridges between Linux boards and microcontrollers, bare-metal C I2C/ADC drivers, and C++ ESC/servo control; deployed production Linux systemd services and resolved 11+ hardware-software integration failures on cross-functional robotics products.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed sensor integration firmware on Raspberry Pi (Linux) combining ADXL345 accelerometers and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands; debugged sensor jitter via z-axis differential thresholding and oscilloscope-guided calibration.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for autonomous locomotive robots; implemented UART and I2C sensor communication with closed-loop feedback for actuator control.
Led cross-functional team of 25 (mechanical, electronics, software) across national-level competitions, owning hardware integration and PCB fabrication end-to-end.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Bridged NVIDIA Jetson (Linux, YOLOv8) and STM32 over UART: Jetson serializes target coordinates; STM32 parses interrupt-driven commands and drives multi-servo PWM in real time.
Implemented FreeRTOS task architecture with mutex-protected shared memory between UART handler and servo control tasks; integrated VL53L0X ToF over I2C with OLED distance feedback.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Delivery Drone
bullets: Wrote and deployed a Linux systemd service on Jetson Orin Nano: SIGTERM/SIGINT handling, WebSocket auto-reconnect loop, keepalive daemon thread, and serial passthrough to Arduino hardware.
Implemented Arduino flight controller in C++: clamped PWM throttle mapping to 4× SimonK ESCs, Bluetooth command parser with arming sequence, and per-motor override logic.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed all peripherals in bare-metal C without HAL abstraction (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); implemented timer-triggered ADC scan, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a custom low-level I2C driver.
Achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified timing and signal integrity in Proteus.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Implemented two-link IK solver on Arduino in C++; drove 5 servos with range-gated contact detection via TCA9548A I2C multiplexer and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors.
Debugged 11 hardware-software integration failures (servo crosstalk, depth error, false detections); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Executed collision-free pick-and-place on physical UR5e via UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability <2mm over 10 trials.
Derived DH tables and FK chains for 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; validated in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic against MoveIt.
